entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return an order. This is unbelievable. I've been trying to figure this out on your website, and it's impossible. I want a refund now.
I can certainly help you with a return. I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. It's a helmet. And let me tell you, if I don't get a full refund, I'm lighting you up on social media. This whole process is a joke.

Thank you for that order number. I'm pulling it up now... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Trail helmet, delivered about 75 days ago. To make sure I'm assisting correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? I don't have time for 20 questions! The color is hideous. It looked completely different online. There is no way I'm wearing this thing. It's been sitting in the box unopened since I got it. Just give me my money back or get me your manager.
I understand completely. The color of your gear is important, and it needs to be right, especially for a key piece of safety equipment. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility for you.
It better be eligible. I'm not eating the cost on this.

Okay, I've checked our policy. Since the helmet is a standard item and you received it 75 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now.
Oh. So it's approved? Just like that? A full refund?
Yes, absolutely. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. The email with the shipping label should be in your inbox now.
Well... okay. I got the email. That was actually pretty easy. I appreciate your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
